description.en: The fire in the middle of the village: the logs and the firewood, Granny Maggie's kettle, the stones round the fire, sparks and smoke, the moon and the stars, the tent, the axe, the bucket and the stump where Old Wilf tells his stories in the evening.
description.sl: Ogenj sredi vasi: polena in drva, kotliček babice Maggie, kamni okoli ognja, iskre in dim, luna in zvezde, šotor, sekira, vedro in štor, kjer stari Wilf zvečer pripoveduje zgodbe.
description.it: Il fuoco in mezzo al villaggio: i ciocchi e la legna, il bollitore di nonna Maggie, i sassi intorno al fuoco, scintille e fumo, la luna e le stelle, la tenda, l'ascia, il secchio e il ceppo dove la sera il vecchio Wilf racconta le sue storie.
description.de: Das Feuer mitten im Dorf: Holzscheite und Brennholz, Oma Maggies Teekessel, die Steine rund ums Feuer, Funken und Rauch, Mond und Sterne, das Zelt, die Axt, der Eimer und der Baumstumpf, auf dem der alte Wilf abends seine Geschichten erzählt.

words.example_en: Come and sit by the fire.
words.example_it: Vieni a sederti vicino al fuoco.
words.example_de: Komm und setz dich ans Feuer.
words.note: By the fire: next to it. Light the fire: make it burn.
words.note_sl: By the fire: ob ognju. Light the fire: zakuriti ogenj.
words.note_it: By the fire: vicino al fuoco. Light the fire: accendere il fuoco.
words.note_de: By the fire: am Feuer. Light the fire: das Feuer anzünden.

words.example_en: Put another log on the fire.
words.example_sl: Daj še eno poleno na ogenj.
words.example_it: Metti un altro ciocco sul fuoco.
words.example_de: Leg noch ein Holzscheit aufs Feuer.
words.note: A log is one piece of wood for the fire. A lot of them: firewood.
words.note_sl: Log je eno poleno. Veliko polen: firewood (drva).
words.note_it: Un log è un ciocco. Tanti insieme: firewood (la legna).
words.note_de: Ein log ist ein Holzscheit. Viele zusammen: firewood (Brennholz).

words.example_en: The kettle is on the fire.
words.example_de: Der Teekessel steht auf dem Feuer.
words.note: 'Put the kettle on!' means 'Let's have a cup of tea!' The British say it all the time.
words.note_sl: »Put the kettle on!« pomeni »Skuhajmo čaj!« Britanci to rečejo ves čas.
words.note_it: «Put the kettle on!» vuol dire «Facciamo un tè!» Gli inglesi lo dicono sempre.
words.note_de: „Put the kettle on!“ heißt „Lass uns Tee trinken!“ Das sagen Briten ständig.

words.example_en: There are big stones round the fire.
words.example_it: Intorno al fuoco ci sono grandi sassi.
words.example_de: Um das Feuer liegen große Steine.
words.note: Round the fire: all around it. A very big stone is a boulder.
words.note_sl: Round the fire: okoli ognja. Zelo velik kamen je boulder (skala).
words.note_it: Round the fire: intorno al fuoco. Un sasso enorme è un boulder (masso).
words.note_de: Round the fire: rund um das Feuer. Ein riesiger Stein ist ein boulder (Felsbrocken).

words.example_en: The smoke goes up to the sky.
words.example_it: Il fumo sale verso il cielo.
words.example_de: Der Rauch steigt in den Himmel.
words.note: Smoke has no plural: a lot of smoke, not smokes.
words.note_sl: Smoke nima množine: a lot of smoke, ne smokes.
words.note_it: Smoke non ha plurale: a lot of smoke, non smokes.
words.note_de: Smoke hat keinen Plural: a lot of smoke, nicht smokes.

words.note: Always the moon, with the: there is only one. The same for the sun and the sky.
words.note_sl: Vedno the moon, s the: luna je samo ena. Enako the sun in the sky.
words.note_it: Sempre the moon, con the: la luna è una sola. Così anche the sun e the sky.
words.note_de: Immer the moon, mit the: es gibt nur einen. Genauso the sun und the sky.

words.note: A shooting star falls across the sky. Make a wish!
words.note_sl: A shooting star: zvezdni utrinek. Zaželi si nekaj!
words.note_it: A shooting star: una stella cadente. Esprimi un desiderio!
words.note_de: A shooting star: eine Sternschnuppe. Wünsch dir was!

words.note: Put up a tent: build it. Take down a tent: pack it away.
words.note_sl: Put up a tent: postaviti šotor. Take down a tent: podreti ga.
words.note_it: Put up a tent: montare la tenda. Take down a tent: smontarla.
words.note_de: Put up a tent: ein Zelt aufbauen. Take down a tent: es abbauen.

words.example_en: Jack chops the wood with an axe.
words.example_it: Jack spacca la legna con l'ascia.
words.example_de: Jack hackt das Holz mit der Axt.
words.note_it: Axe in inglese britannico, ax in americano.

words.example_en: There's water in the bucket for the fire.
words.example_sl: V vedru je voda za ogenj.
words.example_it: Nel secchio c'è l'acqua per il fuoco.
words.example_de: Im Eimer ist Wasser für das Feuer.
words.note: It's bucketing down! means it's raining very hard. You hear it a lot in the Lakes.
words.note_sl: It's bucketing down!: dežuje kot iz škafa. V Lake Districtu to pogosto slišiš.
words.note_it: It's bucketing down!: piove a catinelle. Nel Lake District lo senti spesso.
words.note_de: It's bucketing down!: es gießt wie aus Eimern. Im Lake District hört man das oft.

words.example_en: Old Wilf sits on the stump.
words.example_it: Il vecchio Wilf si siede sul ceppo.
words.example_de: Der alte Wilf sitzt auf dem Baumstumpf.
words.note: A tree stump: what is left when you cut a tree down.
words.note_sl: Tree stump: kar ostane, ko posekaš drevo.
words.note_it: Tree stump: quello che resta quando tagli un albero.
words.note_de: Tree stump: was übrig bleibt, wenn man einen Baum fällt.

words.note: No plural: some firewood, a lot of firewood. One piece is a log.
words.note_sl: Brez množine: some firewood, a lot of firewood. Eno poleno je a log. V slovenščini so drva vedno v množini.
words.note_it: Senza plurale: some firewood, a lot of firewood. Un pezzo è a log.
words.note_de: Kein Plural: some firewood, a lot of firewood. Ein Stück ist a log.

words.example_it: Nonna Maggie fa la cioccolata calda.
words.note: A cup of hot chocolate, or just a hot chocolate. Chocolate has two parts when you say it: CHOK-lət.
words.note_sl: Skodelica vroče čokolade: a cup of hot chocolate. Chocolate se izgovori v dveh zlogih: čok-let.
words.note_it: Una tazza di cioccolata calda: a cup of hot chocolate. Chocolate si pronuncia in due sillabe: ciok-let.
words.note_de: Eine Tasse heiße Schokolade: a cup of hot chocolate. Chocolate spricht man in zwei Silben: tschock-let.

words.example_de: Heute Abend ist es kalt. Mir ist kalt!
words.note: I'm cold, with be. I have a cold means you are ill: a cold is an illness.
words.note_sl: I'm cold (z be): zebe me. I have a cold pa pomeni: {m:prehlajen|f:prehlajena} sem.
words.note_it: I'm cold (con be): ho freddo. I have a cold invece vuol dire: ho il raffreddore.
words.note_de: I'm cold (mit be): mir ist kalt. I have a cold heißt dagegen: ich bin erkältet.

words.example_en: Sit here, love. It's warm by the fire.
words.example_sl: Sedi sem, srček. Ob ognju je toplo.
words.example_it: Siediti qui, tesoro. Vicino al fuoco fa caldo.
words.example_de: Setz dich hierher, Schatz. Am Feuer ist es warm.
words.note: Warm is nice. Hot is very warm: careful!
words.note_sl: Warm je prijetno toplo. Hot je vroče: pazi!
words.note_it: Warm è un caldo piacevole. Hot è molto caldo, scotta: {m:attento|f:attenta}!
words.note_de: Warm ist angenehm. Hot ist heiß: Vorsicht!
